metadata.name: WBM-3072 input-only small-cell study
metadata.selection: sha256(materialmind-v1:ID); ordered initial cells, 2–4 elements, 2–24 sites; input StructureMatcher deduplication
metadata.pretraining_overlap: MPtrj contains prototypes overlapping WBM; independent pretraining generalization is not established
metadata.embedding_model: CHGNet 0.3.0 frozen, CPU, 64-dimensional crystal feature from initial structure
metadata.features: 64 frozen CHGNet graph features plus 20 initial-only cell/composition descriptors
metadata.target: signed distance to fixed MP2020-corrected DFT hull, eV/atom; stable <= 0
metadata.cost: 1 + (initial_nsites/16)^3; synthetic evaluation cost proxy, not measured DFT runtime
metadata.prototype_overlap_scope: Anonymous initial prototypes (chemical suffix removed); chemical-system holdout, not prototype holdout
metadata.evidence: retrospective DFT labels; no new DFT or synthesis

policy.objective: development discoveries at normalized proxy-cost budget

benchmark.study: WBM retrospective adaptation; not official blind Matbench Discovery
benchmark.cost_definition: candidate cost proxy / median training cost; no measured DFT cost

calibrated.ci_scope: Chemical-system cluster bootstrap within this fixed test pool, conditional on fitted model and calibration set.

uncalibrated.ci_scope: Chemical-system cluster bootstrap within this fixed test pool, conditional on fitted model and calibration set.

calibration.note: Chemical-system shift can violate exchangeability; coverage is empirical, not guaranteed.

benchmark.ci_scope: Paired bootstrap over initialization seeds on one fixed test pool; not independent material populations.
limitations: No new DFT, synthesis, or materials discovery claim.
Pretrained model training-data overlap cannot be excluded.
WBM labels used for adaptation, calibration and development; no official blind result.
Cost is an explicit relative proxy, not measured electronic-structure work.
Conformal coverage requires exchangeability; chemical-system shift is evaluated empirically.
Only a bounded subset, a small finite policy search and fixed-kernel GP log-EI baseline.

audit.limits: Retrospective artifact audit; not independent DFT or proof of cryptographic label hiding.
